title: Right approximation is inherited by quasicategorical slices
statement: Use quasicategories, coherent functors, mapping spaces, cores and equivalences of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and join slices with their projection as in [lem-coef-infinity-slice-right-fibration]. Let $A,B$ be quasicategories in a common sufficiently large universe and $G:A\to B$ a functor reflecting equivalence edges. Suppose that for each $a\in A$, $b\in B$ and edge $\psi:b\to G(a)$ there are $v:a'\to a$ and an equivalence $e:b\to G(a')$ with $[G(v)e]=[\psi]$ in $hB$, whose morphism sets are $\pi_0\operatorname{Map}_B(-,-)$. For each $t\in A$, let $G_t:A_{/t}\to B_{/G(t)}$ be the induced functor on join slices. Then $G_t$ reflects equivalences and satisfies right approximation in the slices: for every $a\in A_{/t}$, $b\in B_{/G(t)}$ and edge $\psi:b\to G_t(a)$ there are $v:a'\to a$ in $A_{/t}$ and an equivalence $e:b\to G_t(a')$ in $B_{/G(t)}$ such that $[G_t(v)e]=[\psi]$ in $h(B_{/G(t)})$. This equality is in the slice homotopy category, retaining the compatibility homotopies with the structural maps to $G(t)$. No existence or preservation of limits is assumed.

source.place: Proposition 7.6.5 and Remark 7.6.6, printed p. 387, with weak equivalences the invertible edges; Definition 7.6.1 for right approximation; read online 2026-10-17, not archived in literature/. No Stacks tag states this quasicategorical result.

proof.text: Fix (t\in A). Write (p_A:A_{/t}\to A) and (p_B:B_{/G(t)}\to B) for the initial-face projections of the join slices. By [lem-coef-infinity-slice-right-fibration], both are right fibrations. Reversing simplices turns each into a left fibration, so [lem-cbc-left-fibration-equivalence-lift] says that the projection reflects equivalence edges. If an edge of (A_{/t}) is sent by (G_t) to an equivalence, its underlying edge in (A) is sent by (G) to an equivalence; the hypothesis on (G) then makes the underlying edge an equivalence, and reflection by (p_A) makes the original slice edge an equivalence. Hence (G_t) reflects equivalences.

source.place: Proposition 7.6.5 and Remark 7.6.6, printed p. 387; Definition 7.6.1 for right approximation (online source, not archived)

proof.text: Write $a=(a_0\xrightarrow{\alpha}t)$ and $b=(b_0\xrightarrow{\beta}Gt)$. An edge $\psi:b\to G_t(a)$ is a $2$-simplex in $B$ with sides $\psi_0:b_0\to G(a_0)$, $G\alpha$, and $\beta$. Apply the hypothesis to $\psi_0$, obtaining $v_0:a'_0\to a_0$ and an equivalence $e_0:b_0\to G(a'_0)$ with $[G(v_0)][e_0]=[\psi_0]$. Fill the inner $2$-horn $(e_0,Gv_0)$ in $B$ and call its long edge $w$. By [lem-coef-infinity-mapping-composition], $[w]=[G(v_0)][e_0]=[\psi_0]$ in $\pi_0\operatorname{Map}_B(b_0,G(a_0))$.

source.place: Proposition 7.6.5 and Remark 7.6.6, printed p. 387; Definition 7.6.1 for right approximation (online source, not archived)

proof.text: Make this triangle have the specified long edge $\psi_0$, not just its class. By [lem-coef-infinity-slice-right-fibration], $\operatorname{Map}_B(b_0,G(a_0))$ is Kan. Its two vertices $w,\psi_0$ are in the same component, hence can be joined by a single directed edge: reverse edges with outer $2$-horns and concatenate a finite edge path with inner $2$-horns. By the right-pinched formula of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], choose the corresponding $2$-simplex $H$ with vertices $(b_0,b_0,G(a_0))$ and edges $(\mathrm{id}_{b_0},w,\psi_0)$ on $(01,12,02)$. On vertices $(b_0,b_0,G(a'_0),G(a_0))$, prescribe face $123$ to be the triangle of Step 2, face $013$ to be $H$, and face $012$ to be the degeneracy of $e_0$ repeating its source. These agree on every overlap and form $\Lambda_1^3$. Its filler gives on face $023$ a triangle $\tau$ with edges exactly $(e_0,Gv_0,\psi_0)$.

source.place: Proposition 7.6.5 and Remark 7.6.6, printed p. 387; Definition 7.6.1 for right approximation (online source, not archived)

proof.text: Fill the inner $2$-horn $(v_0,\alpha)$ in $A$, giving a triangle $\sigma$ with long edge $\alpha':a'_0\to t$. Define $a'=(a'_0\xrightarrow{\alpha'}t)$ and let $v:a'\to a$ be the slice edge encoded by $\sigma$. In $B$, on vertices $(b_0,G(a'_0),G(a_0),Gt)$, prescribe face $012$ to be $\tau$, face $123$ to be $G\sigma$, and face $023$ to be the original triangle encoding $\psi$. Their common edges are respectively $Gv_0$, $\psi_0$, and $G\alpha$, so this is a compatible $\Lambda_2^3$. An inner-horn filler has face $013$ an edge $e:b\to G_t(a')$ whose underlying edge is $e_0$. It is an equivalence by reflection through the slice projection, proved in Step 1. The entire $3$-simplex, viewed as $\Delta^2\star\Delta^0\to B$, is a $2$-simplex of $B_{/Gt}$ with edges $(e,G_t(v),\psi)$. Thus its compatibility with the given structural map $\beta$ is retained exactly, not inferred from equality of underlying homotopy classes.

source.place: Proposition 7.6.5 and Remark 7.6.6, printed p. 387; Definition 7.6.1 for right approximation (online source, not archived)

proof.text: Apply [lem-coef-infinity-mapping-composition] to the $2$-simplex in $B_{/Gt}$ from Step 4. This slice is a quasicategory by [lem-coef-infinity-slice-right-fibration], so the conclusion is $[G_t(v)][e]=[\psi]$ in $h(B_{/Gt})$. Together with Step 1 this proves both assertions for arbitrary $t\in A$. The constructions used only the assumed approximation, conservativity, and horn fillings; no limits were assumed.

Step 2: ψ as a map Δ^2→B has edges (ψ0, Gα, β); filling (e0, Gv0) gives w with [w]=[ψ0] by mapping-composition. Step 3: a Map-edge goes from face 02 to face 12, so H=(id,w,ψ0) is an edge ψ0→w in a Kan fiber. The faces s0e0, H and T agree on the edges id, e0 and w; the horn is Λ^3_1 (inner) and face 023 has edges (e0, Gv0, ψ0). Step 4: σ gives v: a'(α')→a(α); the faces τ, Gσ and ψ share the edges Gv0, ψ0 and Gα; the horn is Λ^3_2 (inner). Face 013 is a slice edge b→G_t a' over e0, an equivalence by Step 1, and the 3-simplex is a slice 2-simplex (e, G_t v, ψ) that keeps β exactly. Step 5: mapping-composition in the slice quasicategory. Small cases: G=id, empty A, ordinary nerves. The item is not a restatement of a parent clause. No duplicate turned up in an rg search over dag/nodes. I accept the tool use of lem-cbc-left-fibration-equivalence-lift as a generic black box. No SGA cited, A–F clean, no new nodes, no fixes.

lean.statement: theorem rightApproximation_slice {A B : SSet.{u}} [Quasicategory A] [Quasicategory B] (G : A ⟶ B) (hG : ∀ (e : A _⦋1⦌), IsEquivalenceEdge B (G.app _ e) → IsEquivalenceEdge A e) (happrox : RightApproximation G) (t : A _⦋0⦌) : (∀ (e : (joinSlice (SSet.yonedaEquiv.symm t)) _⦋1⦌), IsEquivalenceEdge (joinSlice (SSet.yonedaEquiv.symm (G.app _ t))) ((joinSlicePostcomp G t).app _ e) → IsEquivalenceEdge (joinSlice (SSet.yonedaEquiv.symm t)) e) ∧ RightApproximation (joinSlicePostcomp G t)
